title: Curtis Mason on Goodreads: 'Best book that I have read this year!'
summary: Mason advises three startup teams headed three different ways: one likely to sell, one on an IPO track, one purpose-driven. His Goodreads review recommends the book to all three whatever their exit path, and he bought it twice over — audiobook and eBook — with paper copies planned for the teams.
blockquote:
I have recommended this book to all 3 teams regardless. There are fantastic principles of governance to be found here.

Best book that I have read this year!
